title: Ukraine Braces For Winter Amid Russian Attacks On Its Energy Sector
summary: As Russian attacks on Ukraine’s energy sector intensify, the Ukrainians are preparing for the 2026-2027 winter. How ready is Ukraine for the cold months ahead?
